result.title: SPROUT: Predicting Objective-Grounded Prompt Utility for Efficient Text-to-Image Preference Tuning
result.summary: Preference tuning of text-to-image diffusion models spends most of its compute generating candidate images, yet training prompts are typically sampled uniformly at random, wasting compute generating images that provide too little signal for model alignment. To best utilize the available compute, we study prompt selection, where at each iteration we identify the most useful prompts for preference tuning. We separate prompt selection into a utility score, an estimator of that utility score, and batch selection. Within this framework, we propose Selection by PRedicting Objective-grounded UTility (SPROUT). The utility score is predicted on every prompt in the pool, including unseen prompts, by a text-only model, refit after every iteration on all utilities observed so far. A randomized acceptance rule then turns these predictions into a batch, so no images are generated beyond those used for training. For direct group preference optimization (DGPO), the objective-grounded utility is the norm of the gradient that the objective produces from a prompt's group of images. Fine-tuning Stable Diffusion 1.5 with DGPO on GenEval, SPROUT matches the final score of uniform sampling in about 44% of the iterations and improves the area under the learning curve with respect to both uniform sampling and CGPO, a recent variance-based prompt sampler. The efficiency gains hold under four held-out reward models never used in training, and the ranking of methods carries over to DPG-Bench and T2I-CompBench++. Our code is available at https://github.com/ADDAPT-ML/SPROUT.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究文本到图像偏好微调中的 prompt 选择问题，提出 SPROUT：用纯文本模型预测以目标梯度范数定义的效用分，并配合随机接受规则组成 batch，以减少生成候选图像的开销。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 无直接关联，但「用廉价代理预测效用、再决定把昂贵生成计算投到哪里」的思路可能为视觉证据筛选、LOOK/THINK 的计算分配及训练样本监督选择提供类比线索，需核查其可迁移性。
